name: Northeastern Brazilian authorial and artisanal fashion (Nordestesse)
description: Authorial labels from Bahia, Ceará, Alagoas, Paraíba and Rio Grande do Norte that work with local artisans (crochet, renda, embroidery, sertão and vaqueiro references) and sell through the Nordestesse platform and the Mãos da Moda project: Catarina Mina, Marina Bitu, Foz, Dendezeiro, Santa Resistência, Inttuí, Teroy13, Areia da Bahia, Somos Dua, Carnavália, Morada, Depedro, Sillas Filgueira, Gefferson Vila Nova.
